title: Chapter 555
text:
F * ck!

Han Xiao's expression changed, and he immediately activated Void Travel, appearing in front of Ashes in a flash. He did not have time to possess the mechanical suit, so he used his best skill and kicked Ashes in the crotch.

Dong!

How sinister! Ashes's face turned green, and he hurriedly raised his hand to block, almost getting kicked in the groin. At the same time, he flew backward. Han Xiao's bare-handed attack without the mechanical suit did not cause much damage, but Ashes' Esper ability was interrupted.

Only then did the mechanical suit possess him, and Han Xiao entered battle mode. He turned around and saw that Hella, who had been hit by Ashes, had lost a leg, and Aurora had lost an arm.

Aurora released a bright golden light from her palm and pressed it on Hella. Hella's leg quickly grew back, and only then did Aurora use her Esper ability to let her arm grow back.

Hella hurriedly carried Aurora and continued to run, her speed increasing. The attack just now made her realize the difference in strength, and she knew that she would only be a burden to Han Xiao if she stayed.

"What a terrifying ability. He has always been dealing with such dangerous enemies …"

A hint of anxiety appeared on her cold and beautiful face.

…

"Luckily, Aurora's Esper ability can even heal disabilities. Her ability seems to have become stronger."

Seeing that the two sisters were fine, Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief.

Hella and Aurora's abilities complemented each other. Although their abilities were weaker, they would not die so easily. Thinking back to when the Germinal Organization broke out, Hella's stomach had a hole in it, but she had survived with her near-death recovery ability. Now, with Aurora by his side, it was equivalent to carrying a super large health potion.

"Can you stop me?"

Ashes did not give chase and immediately changed his target to Han Xiao. The civilians were just bait. He pretended to attack others to force Black Star to stay and fight.

Dozens of black waves shot toward Han Xiao like long snakes. They were as fast as arrows, blotting out the sky and covering the earth. This was not the first time he had fought with Han Xiao. He knew that Han Xiao was not easy to deal with, so he went all out.

The compressed orbs that he always carried with him opened up, and the halo array of the Hovering Shield Shuttles weaved a full-body shield. The torrent of black particles hit the shield fiercely, and countless tiny diamond wheels grinded out countless sparks. The golden light flickered, and the energy ripples continued. Han Xiao was pushed back by the huge force, and his feet dug a trench on the ground.

"An open field is advantageous to him. His grade is higher than mine, and his basic attributes are stronger. I can only hold him back." Han Xiao's expression was grim.

The situation was not good. Ashes was only the vanguard, and there were still two Calamity Grade Supers and a mothership behind him. To Blue Star, this was an overwhelming force.

The only way was to hold on until reinforcements arrived. If Godora wanted his information, he would naturally come.

At this time, a new mission appeared on the interface.

You have triggered the Emergency Mission [Blue Star Crisis]!

Mission Hint: Dark-star suddenly launched a large-scale attack on Blue Star. This planet needs your protection. Try your best to block the enemy.

Mission Requirements: Resist Dark-star forces and protect Blue Star until reinforcements arrive.

Current Destruction Progress: 167/3,000

Failure Condition: Destruction Progress Reaches Maximum

Mission Reward: 62 Experience, + 2 Garton Star System Renown, + 1,500 Six Nations Faction Favorability.

Sudden situations could often trigger Emergency Missions. Not only Han Xiao, but all the players in Blue Star had triggered this Emergency Mission. Inside the Sanctuary, the players all stopped what they were doing and looked up at the sky in shock. Dark-star assault spaceships were flying across the sky and firing at the ground.

The protective shield of Base No.2 slowly expanded. At the same time, the railguns extended out and shot out purplish-blue lightning bolts. The spaceships of the mercenary group also rose into the sky and launched their counterattack.

Why did the enemy suddenly attack? The players were confused. However, dealing with the enemy was more important, and everyone immediately took action.

You have triggered the Emergency Mission [Assassination Target]!

Mission Hint: Your actions have caused huge losses to Dark-star, and their hatred has accumulated day by day. Finally, Dark-star found an opportunity and sent out three Grade A officers to kill you.

Mission Requirements: You will be surrounded by three Grade A Supers. Hold on until reinforcements arrive.

Failure Condition: 1. Death.

2. Escape from Blue Star.

Mission Reward: 1,210 EXP, + 30 Garton Star System Fame, + 1,000 Godora Favorability, + 1 Legendary Point

"The spaceship has already arrived at my spring, and you call that an assassination?" Han Xiao's expression was strange.

The mission notification confirmed that Risda's information was correct.

Through the detection radar, Han Xiao had a clear view of the situation on the battlefield in the sanctuary. Everyone was quickly organizing a counterattack, so he did not need to be distracted.

Han Xiao focused all his attention on Ashes, his eyes sharp.

He could only rely on them to deal with the other enemies. He had to stop Ashes, or there would be countless casualties!

Dong dong dong!

The black particles kept colliding with the shield, almost pressing him into the ground. Han Xiao quickly opened the interface. Without looking at it, he put all the experience he had accumulated into leveling up.

In the past month or so, he had not released many new skills and knowledge to the players, and the experience he had earned was not enough to reach level 140. Facing a strong enemy, every bit of strength counted. Just Ashes, a single Calamity Grade Super, was already difficult to deal with, and there were two enemies of the same level in a while. He had to convert all his resources into combat power.

His experience was quickly depleted.

[Virtual Mechanic] has been leveled up to LV11. + 150 Energy, + 3 DEX, + 3 END, + 6 INT. You have received 6 Free Attribute Points. You have received 1 Potential Point.

The experience points he had accumulated were enough for him to level up 6 times in a row. His total level was now 136!

This time, he did not put his Free Attribute Points into Intelligence. His Intelligence had already exceeded 1,100 points, which was already very high. If it were any other time, he would definitely continue to put all his Free Attribute Points into Intelligence. However, now that he was facing the greatest crisis in history, it was not appropriate to continue increasing his Intelligence.

Han Xiao threw all 36 Free Attribute Points into Endurance to ensure his survival. He was very clear that with his current combat strength, even if he used the Mech Legion, it would still be very difficult to defeat a Calamity Grade Super. Furthermore, the enemy had three Calamity Grade Supers, so the only way to survive was to use his own body to tank them.

He still had a few more chances to use the Aurora Character Summon Card, and the two Molding Talents that he had obtained from the Mutation Source were even more important. Under such circumstances, the higher his health, the more effective these trump cards would be.

His Endurance had increased by a total of 18 + 36 = 54 points. Using his own template and level conversion, that was an additional 4,752 HP!

His health had broken through the 40000 mark!

The higher his level, the greater the difference. Han Xiao's health had increased by six levels, which was more than the total health of a level 60 player.

A surge of heat spread out in his body. Han Xiao became spirited.

His spirit was aroused, and he clasped his palms together.

Klaala!

Eight mechanical hands appeared, turning into drill bits to counterattack, continuously attacking the diamond barrier around Ashes' body.

Han Xiao bent his legs, and the propellers on his feet exploded, sending out wave after wave of black waves. With a wave of his hands, he threw out a large number of compressed orbs, which turned into various floating cannons, firing an endless rain of bullets at Ashes.

The entire street had already been leveled by the shockwaves from the battle between the two of them, and they could not be bothered to destroy the outer area of the sanctuary. Han Xiao threw out another two compressed orbs, and the two Oathkeepers, 'Fighter' and 'Cannoneer', appeared to protect him. They clashed with the black waves controlled by Ashes time and time again.

Bang bang bang!

The two of them were in a stalemate, unable to do anything to each other.

Ashes wanted to control the particles to destroy the internal structure of the machines. Han Xiao had been hit by this trick before, so he was already prepared. He released a large number of Hovering Shield Shuttles, covering many machines with simple energy shields to prevent the particles from entering.

The two of them fought fiercely, like a huge black snake fighting with a steel fortress. They moved around the outside of the sanctuary, and everywhere they passed, ruins were left behind.

At this moment, a golden light shot from afar like a meteor, slamming into the black snake under Ashes' feet. The snake's head exploded, and a rumbling sound was heard.

Ashes's eyes narrowed, and he hurriedly controlled the black wave under his feet to float. The golden iron fist almost hit his chin.

Nagojin, surrounded by golden flames, landed beside Han Xiao, standing side by side, glaring at Ashes.

Nagojin's entrance temporarily interrupted the battle between the two.

"Black Star, are you okay?"

"Don't worry, he won't be able to hurt me."

Han Xiao turned to look at Nagojin and said with a deep voice, "Have the reinforcements arrived?"

Nagojin's expression was grave, and he shook his head.

"I have already informed the War Bureau, and the fleets from the other calamity planets will rush over through the hyperdrive base station. Originally, it would only take about three minutes, but Dark-star has set up a spatial disturbance device in outer space, preventing us from sending reinforcements. It will take even longer for the reinforcements to arrive."

If the Blue Star fleet had not retreated, they would have been able to delay the reinforcements. However, the War Bureau had placed all their attention on destroying Dark-star. Seeing that the calamity on Blue Star had been resolved, they retracted their fleet according to the original plan.

Furthermore, the victory on Planet Golden Gate made them think that Dark-star would stop for a while. They did not expect Dark-star to act so quickly.

"Thankfully, the enemy is only a single Calamity Grade Super. He is Ashes, the one who massacred tens of millions of people in Long Arc Constellation. I will fight alongside you and get rid of him as soon as possible."

Nagojin stared at Ashes and was ready to make a move.

Ashes's expression changed slightly. He was wary and furious. It was the two people in front of him who had killed Anur, and he still remembered it clearly.

The fleet had already retreated, so why was there still a high-level combatant from Godora left behind?

Ashes frowned. His mission was to stall Black Star, and he could do it with ease. However, if Nagojin was added into the mix, his hands would be tied.

"Only with Degulish and Terry will we be able to win in a three versus two situation. Thankfully, they do not know that there are two people lying in ambush here. We might even be able to get rid of a Godora expert. Buy one, get one free."

Ashes was confident and looked at the two of them coldly.

This time, Han Xiao grabbed onto Nagojin's shoulder and said with a deep voice, "Don't do it.

I will stall him. You go deal with the assault spaceships in the sky. Tell Herlous to bring a portion of the Inhumans to reinforce the Six Nations. You and I, as well as the defensive shield and anti-air weapons, are still in good condition. The Six Nations are the ones in danger and urgently need reinforcements! "

Nagojin was surprised and frowned.

"What do you mean by that? If the two of us work together, we will be able to get rid of him very quickly, just like in Noriose."

"It won't be that easy." Han Xiao waved his hands.

The last time, he had the Dragon Emperor Character Summon Card, which had destroyed Anur's defenses and given Nagojin a chance to practice military boxing. This time, he did not have a Character Summon Card and would not be able to kill Ashes in a short period of time.

Rather than that, it would be better for him to stall Ashes while Nagojin returned to defend the base. In just a short while, the destruction progress had increased by more than four hundred points. He had to stop the assault spaceships.

Furthermore, there would be another two Calamity Grade Supers ambushing him in a while, and he would be able to stall three high-level combatants by himself. With the Aurora Character Summon Card and his two Molding Talents, it would be extremely difficult for the enemy to kill him.

However, if Nagojin was beside him, the situation would be different. If the three Dark-star turned around and surrounded Nagojin, Nagojin would be in danger. Although he was a Grade A Pugilist, his defense was far from being as thick as Han Xiao's.

"Alright, I'll leave him to you!"

Nagojin clenched his teeth. Since Han Xiao insisted, he could only choose to believe in his comrade. He looked deeply at Ashes before turning around and running back to the base.

Seeing this, Ashes looked at Han Xiao with a mocking gaze.

Mission complete. Black Star fell for it!

He actually rejected Nagojin's help and stayed behind to deal with me? You asked for it yourself!

When Degulish and Terry arrive, you won't be able to run even if you want to!

From his perspective, Han Xiao did not know that there was an ambush.

Ashes was secretly delighted. He really wanted to see how panicked Black Star would be when the ambush appeared!

At this time, the entire Sanctuary was burning with flames, and chaos could be seen everywhere. The sound of cannon fire, screams, and screams could be heard everywhere. DarkStar had brought a direct disaster to this planet, and stopping the Mutation Disaster would result in a retaliatory attack.

Han Xiao took a deep breath, suppressed the frustration in his heart, and ignored the chaos in the outside world. As a Chaos Believer who took most things lightly, he could quickly regain his calmness during a battle and throw all the losses and casualties out of his mind.

Ashes stepped on the black tide and floated in midair, looking down at Han Xiao with killing intent on his face.

If it was just Black Star alone, he would not have to be afraid.

"You haven't reached the Calamity Grade yet, right? How are you going to deal with me if you don't set up a trap ahead of time?"

Hearing this, Han Xiao's voice sounded from the mechanical suit's helmet.

"The last time we fought was more than a year ago. Your strength hasn't improved, but I'm different from you … Philip, release all the armies!"

"Understood, hum …"

Hu!

Risda was not around, and Philip replaced him in controlling the Blacklight Stealth, passing through the battlefield between the spaceships and the mercenaries before arriving above Han Xiao. Numerous Army Boxes with different numbers were spat out from the bottom of the spaceship, and they flew toward the area where Han Xiao was located like rockets.

Han Xiao's eyes lit up, and he raised his right hand toward the sky. Surging Mechanical Force shot into the sky like countless lightning whips, connecting all the Army Boxes.
